description: This file defines a simple Android home screen widget that displays the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary. It includes a widget provider class 'WordWidget' and an internal service 'UpdateService' responsible for fetching data from the API, parsing it, and updating the widget UI accordingly.

classes.name: WordWidget
classes.description: Main widget provider class extending AppWidgetProvider to handle update triggers.

classes.name: WordWidget.UpdateService
classes.description: An Android Service class responsible for performing the API request, parsing response, and updating the widget UI.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Triggered when the widget needs to be updated; starts the UpdateService.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles the lifecycle event of the service, initiates building the widget update.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Builds the widget RemoteViews by fetching and parsing the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary API.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not needed for this service.
